posts.title: Errachidia → Merzouga: distance, duration and tips
posts.excerpt: Everything about the road between Errachidia and Merzouga: travel time, road condition, and which vehicle to choose.
body: The Errachidia–Merzouga route is one of the most popular trips in south-east Morocco. It takes you from Errachidia airport or city to the Erg Chebbi dunes.
## Distance and duration
Expect about 140–150 km depending on the route, or roughly 1 h 45 to 2 h 15 in normal conditions. The road is fully paved and in good condition for most of the journey.
## Which vehicle to choose?
A city car, sedan or standard SUV is enough to reach Merzouga. A 4x4 is not required for this road, but becomes useful if you plan tracks around the dunes or access to certain desert camps.
## Practical tips
Leave early to avoid the heat, fill up in Errachidia, and keep water in the car. Mamou Sahara can arrange pick-up at Errachidia airport and delivery toward Merzouga if needed.

posts.title: Do you need a 4x4 to go to Merzouga?
posts.excerpt: Paved road or tracks? We explain when a standard car is enough and when a 4x4 becomes useful.
body: Many travellers wonder whether they absolutely need a 4x4 to reach Merzouga. The answer is nuanced.
## To reach the village
The road from Errachidia to Merzouga is fully paved. A city car, sedan or standard SUV is enough to reach the village centre and hotels on the edge of the dunes.
## When a 4x4 becomes useful
A 4x4 (or high-clearance SUV) is recommended if you want to: reach certain camps on tracks; drive around the Erg Chebbi dunes off the main roads; gain comfort and safety on rough tracks.
## Our advice
For a simple village + hotel trip, a normal car is enough. To explore tracks and the desert, choose a 4x4 such as the Ford Ranger Raptor. Mamou Sahara will advise you based on your plan.

posts.title: Car rental Errachidia airport: practical guide
posts.excerpt: Pick up your vehicle at Moulay Ali Cherif Airport: process, tips and WhatsApp booking.
body: Errachidia airport (Moulay Ali Cherif, code ERH) is the ideal entry point to reach Merzouga and south-east Morocco with a rental car.
## How does pick-up work?
Give us your flight number when booking. We meet you on arrival with the vehicle ready. Key handover is quick: vehicle check, contract signature, and you are on your way.
## Timing and organisation
We adapt to flights, including early morning or evening. Share your schedule on WhatsApp so everything is ready when you land.
## On to Merzouga
From the airport, allow about 2 hours to Merzouga. A standard car is enough for the paved road; a 4x4 is a plus for tracks around the dunes.

conditions.subtitle: Clear and simple terms for your rental in Errachidia, Merzouga and all over Morocco.
conditions.metaDescription: Car rental terms: age, licence, deposit, fuel, insurance and cancellation. Clear and simple.
body: The terms below apply to every rental with Mamou Sahara. Exact details (deposit, options) are confirmed before booking on WhatsApp.
## Age and licence
Minimum age: 21, with a driving licence valid for at least 1 year. Some premium or 4x4 vehicles may require 25 years. An international permit may be requested depending on your country.
## Deposit
A deposit is required according to the vehicle type. It is held or charged at pick-up and returned after inspection on return, subject to damage or missing items.
## Insurance
Basic insurance is generally included. Excesses, extensions and extra options (fully comprehensive, additional driver) are confirmed before booking.
## Fuel and mileage
The vehicle is handed over with an agreed fuel level (often full / full). Included mileage and any extra fees are stated at booking.
## Cancellation and changes
Free cancellation up to 48 h before pick-up. After that, fees may apply. Date or vehicle changes are made via WhatsApp subject to availability.
## Pick-up and return
Possible locations: Errachidia airport, Errachidia city, Merzouga, or another city in Morocco (delivery). Vehicle condition is checked with you at departure and return.
